name: Switchboard
pitch: A continuous tube becomes a compact P: precise routing for your personal devices.
tradeoffs: More infrastructural and less overtly playful than the other directions; the P monogram can need the wordmark before the Pneumo name becomes familiar.
concept: A 1970s wayfinding system translated into a personal-device switchboard: cool cobalt carries the active route while concrete neutrals make the system feel tactile, ordered, and dependable.
markNotes: A single chunky route folds through squared switchboard corners into a P. Its stepped outer turn and open counter stay distinct at 16px without becoming an arrow, chain link, or medical symbol.
typeNotes: Chivo SemiBold gives the lowercase wordmark compact geometric authority and slightly industrial terminals. Public Sans keeps interface copy calm, highly legible, and secondary to the routing graphic.
